guide.summary: Sandbox-only build and testing (self-serve, wait none); Public app listed on Clover App Market (app review).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Sandbox-only build and testing (self-serve, wait none). Hardest: Public app listed on Clover App Market (app review).

composio.note: Clover is in Composio's bring-your-own-OAuth-app list. Create the auth config with your own Clover credentials and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio provides no managed OAuth app for Clover, so you must create your own Clover app and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: Composio lists Clover under bring-your-own OAuth app, with no managed option
Production use by outside merchants requires your own approved developer account and app
Own app gives your branding, dedicated quota and custom scopes

scenarios.label: Sandbox-only build and testing
scenarios.when_this_applies: You only use the Clover sandbox environment, with no real merchants.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; c1

waiting.basis: No account approval needed for sandbox only (c1)

scenarios.approval: No account approval is needed for sandbox-only use.

scenarios.label: Public app listed on Clover App Market
scenarios.when_this_applies: Outside Clover merchants install your app from the Clover App Market in production.

hands_on.basis: estimate from step count, not measured; identity docs, video, listing content (c4, c12)

waiting.basis: No official timeline found; one developer reported 7 weeks of silence (c18)

extras: OFAC check repeats monthly; revisions are re-reviewed

prerequisites.title: Owner role on the developer account
prerequisites.detail: Only an Owner can edit account settings and accept the Clover Developer Agreement.

prerequisites.title: Identity and business documents
prerequisites.detail: Have a passport or driver's license, proof of address, and for companies a tax ID plus proof of business address ready.

prerequisites.title: Your own Clover app credentials
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Clover app, so you supply your own client ID and secret.

steps.title: Create global developer account
steps.detail: Sign up and choose Individual or Business account type. Submit your details, which also agrees to the Developer Terms.
inputs: Company legal name and tax ID if Business
steps.done_when: Production developer account submitted for verification.

steps.title: Upload requested verification documents
steps.detail: If Clover's business team asks, upload documents to the secure Clover Box, not by email, within 10 business days.

steps.title: Wait for developer account approval
steps.detail: Clover verifies identity and runs an OFAC sanctions check. No timeline is documented.

steps.title: Create app and set REST configuration
steps.detail: Create the app, set REST Clients to Web, enter the Site URL, and set Default OAuth Response to Code.
steps.done_when: App Settings saved and RAID shown.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config via Composio's API with your Clover client ID and secret. Copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.
steps.done_when: Auth config created and redirect URI registered.

steps.title: Draft functional description and demo script
steps.detail: Draft the primary use case description and a script for the walkthrough video.

steps.title: Record and upload functional video
steps.detail: Record the workflow video and add its URL and the description in the Functional Review section.

steps.title: Complete checklist and submit app
steps.detail: Finish all settings and listing on the Submission Checklist, then click Submit for Approval.

steps.title: Wait for App Market review
steps.detail: Clover reviews function, bugs and merchant value. Timeline is not documented.

traps.title: Possible rejection of AI apps
traps.detail: One developer reported Clover's legal team rejected an AI voice-agent app because no policy for third-party AI apps existed. This is a secondhand report.

traps.title: Left on sandbox or broken redirect link
traps.detail: Clover's developer advocate says leaving the code on Sandbox or a broken redirect link causes failures during testing.

traps.title: Transactions must use the Clover network
traps.detail: Apps that also use another processor are a rejection risk.

traps.title: Missed document deadline
traps.detail: Documents not supplied within 10 business days may lead to rejection.

traps.title: Post-launch changes get reviewed
traps.detail: Revisions to approved apps, including permissions and legal links, go through review again.

blockers.symptom: Verify your Developer Account banner in production
blockers.what_it_means: Your production developer account is not yet verified, so app approval cannot start.

blockers.symptom: Submit for Approval button is unavailable

open_questions: How long do developer account verification and app review take? Not documented; ask Clover developer support.
Does a merchant admin need to approve installing the app? Docs say no limits on merchants but do not address admin approval; ask Clover support.
Which permissions trigger extra scrutiny at first review? Not found; ask Clover DevRel.
Can a non-Market (private or single-merchant) app be used by outside merchants without review? The app-approval page was not found; check Clover's app approval documentation.
Does Clover's redirect-URI handling require domain verification? Not found; check REST Configuration docs.

The quotes state the provider reviews apps and must verify and approve the production developer account before the app can be used.
